statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229, is ordered
The service is to capture and characterize intermittent arrhythmic events
The denial reason is CO-22 (care may be covered by another payer)
